item: stream_backup._corpus_facts table-count loop ends in a guard clause so an interrupt cannot skip the finally that closes the connection (R163)
summary: The scale-bench CLI reaches the loop on the main thread; its last statement was a bare if, which CPython 3.13 leaves outside the try's exception table. Now if not _SAFE_ID.match(t): continue; counts unchanged. The dis test imports _uncovered_loop_heads from tests/test_gates_survive_an_interrupt.py, so it is red until that follow-on is in the base.
